ttl_discipline_verdict: PASS — every Cache::put/remember/add observed in app/ carries an explicit TTL (5s … 7 days). No infinite caches; no forget-only orphan keys. Idempotency markers all bounded ≤24h, micro-caches ≤5s, payload cache ≤60s default.

chain_evidence.step_1_admin_rupture_click: Admin clicks rupture toggle → POST /api/admin/menu/availability/branch/{branch} → routes to AvailabilityController → AvailabilityService::toggle() (Menu/AvailabilityService.php:40-86)
chain_evidence.step_2_stock_service_for_central: When central stock decrements (StockService::decrementForOrder via OrderCreated), Stock/StockService.php:131 calls syncItemAvailabilityForStockLevel(level, branchId) which flips ItemBranchAvailability when on_hand crosses 0 (lines 162-215)
chain_evidence.step_3_event_dispatched: ItemAvailabilityChanged::forBranch(itemId, branchId, isAvailable, reason) dispatched after commit (Menu/AvailabilityService.php:385-393 via DB::afterCommit) — also dispatched from StockService:149-160 wrapper. DispatchableAfterCommit trait guarantees commit-before-dispatch (NF525 §8 ordering invariant).
chain_evidence.step_4_listeners_wired: EventServiceProvider.php:216-224 maps ItemAvailabilityChanged → [BumpMenuSnapshotOnItemAvailabilityChanged, InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged, PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox, PersistItemAvailabilityChangedToOutbox]. ItemUpdated → [InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange, PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox] (lines 264-267, I.3 heal cba372066).
chain_evidence.step_5_broadcast_to_branch_channel: PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox.php:83 writes `channel = ['private-branch.{branchId}']` + `broadcast_as = 'CatalogChanged'` to domain_events outbox. DispatchDomainEventsJob picks it up and fires Pusher broadcast. Echo channel registered in routes/channels.php:41-62 as `branch.{branchId}` (Laravel prefixes `private-` automatically on private() subscribe). Authorization: kiosk-token → machine.branch_id match; Admin/Tenant Admin → cross-branch; staff → own branch.
chain_evidence.step_6_kiosk_subscriber: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskAppComponent.vue:554 listens broadcastAs:'CatalogChanged' on private-branch.{id}. Hands off to useCatalogChangeNotifier.js:283-422 → onCatalogChanged() → triggers fetchMenu({force:true}) which bypasses the FE memory cache.
chain_evidence.step_8_be_cache_forget: InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged (item rupture) AND InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange (ItemUpdated/Created/Deleted/Category*/Composer*/StockLevelChanged/ItemExtra*/ItemVariation*) both call Cache::forget('kiosk.menu.branch.{branchId}'). The InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange listener additionally bumps MenuSnapshot version so polling clients also see the version flip. The next /api/frontend/menu hit (Kiosk re-fetch within ms of receiving Echo) re-builds the payload via KioskMenuService::build() with fresh ItemBranchAvailability + StockLevel rows — closing the loop.
chain_evidence.step_9_kds_subscriber_note: KDS is order-flow not catalog-flow — it does not subscribe to CatalogChanged. KDS receives KdsOrderRecalled / OrderStatusChanged / OrderCreated on the same private-branch.{id} channel (per Events/KdsOrderRecalled.php docblock). Central stock rupture does not need to reach KDS because KDS displays IN-FLIGHT orders, not the orderable catalog. This is a deliberate scope decision, not a gap.

findings.title: Snapshot bump performed on Cache::forget in InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange but NOT in InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged
findings.detail: InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange.php:53 calls `$this->snapshot->bump($branchId)` after Cache::forget(). InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged.php:69-78 only calls Cache::forget — it relies on BumpMenuSnapshotOnItemAvailabilityChanged (sibling listener in the SAME EventServiceProvider:217 array) to bump separately. Both listeners run synchronously in the listed order so the bump still happens before the next /api/frontend/menu hit, but the symmetric path through CatalogChanged proves a more local pattern (forget+bump atomically). Not a bug — pattern is consistent because EventServiceProvider explicitly chains both — but it is an asymmetry worth knowing about if either listener is ever removed in isolation.

findings.title: Cache driver coherence for kiosk.menu.branch.{id} relies on shared cache store across workers
findings.detail: Cache::forget on kiosk.menu.branch.{id} must reach the SAME store that Cache::remember populated in MenuController.php:71. CLAUDE.md §8 boot guard forbids `array`/`null` drivers in production (AppServiceProvider:215). However the same CLAUDE.md note (2026-05-21) flags that `file` and `database` PASS the guard — both ARE per-instance-coherent on V1 LOCAL single-box, but a future cloud ALB multi-instance migration would break this listener silently for the FILE driver (FS not shared across instances). Already tracked as V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog UNI-03. RE-CONFIRM-no-action-needed for V1 LOCAL.

findings.title: Cache::add idempotency guard at AvailabilityService.php:321 vulnerable to mid-day FLUSHALL (already documented inline)
findings.detail: The per-order Cache::add('availability:decremented:...') guard prevents OrderCreated replay double-counting `daily_consumed_qty`. CLAUDE.md-equivalent inline comment at lines 305-311 already documents the blast radius: if cache is flushed mid-day (incident, deploy, manual clear), a single re-dispatched order COULD double-count once. Mitigated by the fact that `daily_consumed_qty` is a UX quota counter, NOT a fiscal counter — `stock_movements.idempotency_key` (StockService.php:97-103) remains the NF525-adjacent SSOT, observable via catalog warning dashboard. Treated as accepted residual risk per HEAL-C.1 audit doc — not a new finding from this audit, restated here for chain completeness.

verdict_rationale: Central stock toggle propagation chain verified end-to-end: AvailabilityService/StockService → ItemAvailabilityChanged (after-commit) → 4 listeners in EventServiceProvider (snapshot bump + cache forget + outbox persist x2) → DispatchDomainEventsJob → Pusher broadcast on private-branch.{id} channel → Kiosk Echo subscriber refetches via fetchMenu({force:true}) bypassing FE memory cache → KioskMenuService::build() reads fresh ItemBranchAvailability rows after BE Cache::forget. I.3 heal commit cba372066 intact (4 files all present, ItemUpdated event wired, sentinel test still active). 17 cache sites inventoried, every Cache::put/remember/add has explicit TTL ≤ 7 days, no orphan infinite caches. 3 INFO findings (asymmetric bump pattern, cloud-prep driver coherence already in backlog, accepted residual on idempotency guard mid-day flush) — none blocking V1 LOCAL ship.
